items.title: Kodak’s next collectible is a tiny digital photo frame that doubles as a tracker

items.summary: After expanding its Charmera collection with a Millennium Edition featuring Y2K-inspired designs earlier this year, Reto's follow-up to its tiny Kodak camera is an equally small digital photo frame you can use to display your shots.
items.summary_zh: 今年早些时候，Reto 推出了受 Y2K 启发设计的千禧版，扩展了 Charmera 系列，之后又推出了小型柯达相机的后续产品，即一款同样小型的数码相框，您可以用它来展示您的照片。

items.title: Spain Pitches Incentives, Crews and a 500 Million-Strong Spanish-Speaking Market to India at WAVES Film Bazaar

items.summary: Spain, the Country of Honor at this year’s International Film Festival of India (IFFI), made its case to Indian filmmakers at WAVES Film Bazaar in Goa, laying out its incentives, locations and crews and pushing for closer co-production ties.
items.summary_zh: 作为今年印度国际电影节 (IFFI) 的主宾国，西班牙在果阿举行的 WAVES 电影义卖会上向印度电影制片人阐述了自己的观点，介绍了其激励措施、地点和工作人员，并推动了更紧密的联合制作关系。
